title: Area Is Multiplication
topic: Area of rectangles as length x width; connection to 2-digit multiplication

items.prompt: A rectangle has a length of 14 units and a width of 6 units. What is its area?
items.rationale: Area = length x width = 14 x 6 = 84 square units.

items.prompt: The area of a rectangle is found by:

choices.C: Dividing the length by the width

items.rationale: Area of a rectangle = length x width.

items.prompt: A Nerf dart lands and forms a rectangle 23 units by 17 units. What is the area?
A student says, "The area of a 5-by-8 rectangle is 5 + 8 = 13." What mistake did the student make?

choices.B: The student added the side lengths instead of multiplying them
choices.C: The student used the wrong shape
choices.D: The student forgot to label units

items.rationale: Area requires multiplying the side lengths, not adding them: 5 x 8 = 40.

items.prompt: Which unit is appropriate for describing the area of a rectangle whose sides are measured in feet?
items.rationale: Area is measured in square units, since it comes from multiplying two length measurements.
